concepts.title: Reference assembly
concepts.instruction: Draw the 50 mm cube and the centred 30 mm square pyramid base with 50 mm pyramid height.

concepts.title: Cube base
concepts.instruction: Construct the horizontal 50 mm isometric rhombus from the 30° axes.

concepts.title: Cube height and top
concepts.instruction: Erect 50 mm verticals and close the top face.

concepts.title: Centred pyramid base
concepts.instruction: Locate the top-face centre with diagonals and inset 10 mm from each cube side to form the 30 mm base square.

concepts.title: Pyramid apex
concepts.instruction: Raise the vertical axis 50 mm from the centre of the pyramid base.

concepts.title: Slant edges
concepts.instruction: Join the apex to each base corner individually, retaining all source construction lines.

concepts.title: Finish dimensions
concepts.instruction: Add the 30 mm base dimension, both 50 mm heights and the cube dimensions.
